resources.string: Lets a program on your computer read the Computer desktop state and take screenshots. It listens on the phone only (127.0.0.1), not on Wi-Fi. It is read-only unless you allow control below. Connect with adb forward.
Allow control: run commands, click and type. Each request asks you here first.
Control is on. POST /v1/computer/exec or /v1/computer/gui; each request waits for your Allow (2 minutes, then it is denied).

On your computer run: adb forward tcp:%1$d tcp:%1$d
Then call http://127.0.0.1:%1$d/v1/computer/state
with the header: Authorization: Bearer %2$s
The API stops at %3$s.
Lets a paired device on the same Wi-Fi use the Computer API over HTTPS. Only devices that pair with the code below get access. Stops after 5 minutes without use or 30 minutes in total.
No pairing code. Make a new one to pair another device.
Scan the QR code, or POST {\"code\": \"…\", \"name\": \"…\"} to /v1/pair and use the returned token as a Bearer token.
